# URI reference

The grammar:

```text
frida://<action>/<transport>/<device>/<target>
```

## Actions

| Action | Target required | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | no (must be empty) | enumerate processes on the device |
| `apps` | no (must be empty) | enumerate applications on the device |
| `attach` | yes | attach to a running process |
| `spawn` | yes | start the target. Local stays suspended, USB/remote resume (`rn` true when RegisterNatives armed) |
| `launch` | yes | start the target and resume it |

## Transports and devices

| Transport | Device field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `local` | empty | the host itself |
| `usb` | empty | the single connected device |
| `usb` | device id | a specific device (see `fridadj`) |
| `remote` | `host:port` | a frida-server listening on TCP |

## Targets

| Target | Works for |
|---|---|
| decimal pid | attach, spawn (local/remote), launch |
| process name (the app label on Android) | attach |
| package name | spawn, launch (Android) |
| executable path | spawn, launch (local). Absolute paths need a leading slash |

## Examples

```text
frida://attach/local//1234          attach to local pid 1234
frida://attach/usb//FridaMin        attach by name on the USB device
frida://attach/usb/device-1/4321    attach on device-1
frida://attach/remote/127.0.0.1:27042/4321   remote attach
frida://spawn/usb//re.frida.minapp  spawn a USB package (resumed, rn true if the hook armed)
frida://spawn/local///bin/ls        spawn /bin/ls suspended (absolute path, three slashes)
frida://spawn/local//./native_demo  spawn ./native_demo suspended (relative path)
frida://launch/local///bin/ls       launch and resume /bin/ls
frida://list/usb//                  processes on the USB device
frida://apps/remote/10.0.0.5:27042/ applications over remote
```

## Validation examples (`fridauj`)

```text
[0x00000000]> fridauj frida://attach/local//1234
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","transport":"local","device":"","target":"1234"}}

[0x00000000]> fridauj frida://spawn/usb/device-1/com.example.app
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"spawn","transport":"usb","device":"device-1","target":"com.example.app"}}

[0x00000000]> fridauj frida://launch/local///bin/ls
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"launch","transport":"local","device":"","target":"/bin/ls"}}
```

## Rules

- action and transport are required, non-empty, and must be known
- attach/spawn/launch require a non-empty target
- list/apps require an empty target
- local must have an empty device, remote must carry `host:port`, usb may
  be empty or a device id
- there is no percent-encoding. Slashes in paths are kept after the empty
  device field
- pid-vs-name resolution happens at attach time, not in the URI parser
- `fridaoj` adds `frida://` if omitted. `fridau`, `fridap`, and `fridaa` require it
